lines.text: Your best knowledge already exists. It is just scattered.
Because it is structured, AI can work with meaning. It proposes. You decide.
Write it once. It lives everywhere it is needed, and changes everywhere at once.
Nothing ships until a person approves it.
One source adapts to the audience in front of it.
And to the language it is read in.
From there it moves outward. Documentation, support, learning, and AI.
One intelligent content layer, connecting what you know to everyone who needs it.
